clue.text: Stone, a short time before last of Viagra, gains endurance

indicators.note: last of asks only for the final letter of the following word

blocks.note: ST is the standard abbreviation for stone, the weight
taken as written

the final letter of the drug's name

explanation.surface: A man takes a pill shortly before the big moment and finds he can last longer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'before' simply places the minute ahead of the last letter of Viagra.
explanation.definitionFit: Stamina is the staying power to keep going, which is what endurance means.

explanation.definitionFit: Hair or tissue that grows back is regrowth, a further lengthening after the first, hence an extension again.
